headline: Tk 16.25 crore gold seized: 80 gold bars found in shoes of airport staff
summary: Customs officials recovered 9.34kg of gold from two airline staff members arriving from Dubai at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
details: Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars weighing approximately 9.34kg from the shoes of two airline staff members at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today.
Acting on a tip-off, the Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) intercepted the two staff members as they arrived on Emirates Airlines flight EK0582 from Dubai.
The gold bars, each weighing around 117 grammes, were concealed inside the shoes using a special method to evade customs checks.
The total estimated market value of the seized gold is approximately Tk 16.25 crore, according to customs officials.
The CIID is currently investigating the origin of the gold, the intended recipient, and other individuals involved in the smuggling attempt.
caption:
80 gold bars hidden in shoes! Customs officials seize Tk 16.25 crore worth of gold at Dhaka airport.

Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars weighing approximately 9.34kg from the shoes of two airline staff members at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today.

Acting on a tip-off, the Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) intercepted the two staff members as they arrived on Emirates Airlines flight EK0582 from Dubai.

The gold bars, each weighing around 117 grammes, were concealed inside the shoes using a special method to evade customs checks.

The total estimated market value of the seized gold is approximately Tk 16.25 crore, according to customs officials.

The CIID is currently investigating the origin of the gold, the intended recipient, and other individuals involved in the smuggling attempt.

headline: 1,125 dead as measles outbreak death toll reaches 1,125

Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the death toll continues to rise.
